title: Uniform Tor amplitude zero for the completed regular coefficient unit
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a finite-field datum D with l different from its characteristic, and a scheme W where l is invertible in all residue fields, the completed regular coefficient object satisfies CompletedUnitPullback.Admissible: it is integral constructible with finite Tor amplitude, its actual finite reduction maps are isomorphisms, and all reductions have cohomological and Tor interval [0,0] and locally constant finite regular degree-zero sheaf. These are the actual objects of [def-pur-completed-unit-pullback-data], using [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible] and Tor amplitude of [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].

source.place: Sections 3.5 and 6.5, Lemmas 6.5.9 and 6.8.2; regular-module calculation in lem-pur-completed-unit-pullback-tower

proof.text: Use existing constructibility and actual quotient isomorphisms. At each finite level the single complex of the regular module has flat terms: the zero terms are flat and the nonzero term is the monoidal unit. Apply the finite flat-model criterion and transport along the actual reduction isomorphism. The same interval [0,0] works at every level.
